# Defaults профиля Splatfacto

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

[Смысл полей и ограничения](./config.md#профиль-splatfacto). Параметры utility имеют kebab-case, а JSON — snake_case. У `recon-config` флаги профиля дополнительно имеют prefix `--splatfacto-`.

| Поле JSON | Тип | Default | Utility flag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_num_iterations` | integer | `60000` | `--max-num-iterations` |
| `stop_split_at` | integer | `32000` | `--stop-split-at` |
| `cull_alpha_thresh` | number | `0.02` | `--cull-alpha-thresh` |
| `densify_grad_thresh` | number | `0.0003` | `--densify-grad-thresh` |
| `densify_size_thresh` | number | `0.0075` | `--densify-size-thresh` |
| `split_screen_size` | number | `0.03` | `--split-screen-size` |
| `num_downscales` | integer | `1` | `--num-downscales` |
| `resolution_schedule` | integer | `2000` | `--resolution-schedule` |
| `cull_scale_thresh` | number | `0.1` | `--cull-scale-thresh` |
| `stop_screen_size_at` | integer | `32000` | `--stop-screen-size-at` |
| `use_scale_regularization` | boolean | `true` | `--use-scale-regularization` |
| `max_gauss_ratio` | number | `10.0` | `--max-gauss-ratio` |
| `sh_degree` | integer | `2` | `--sh-degree` |
| `mask_threshold` | integer | `127` | `--mask-threshold` |
| `mask_erosion_pixels` | integer | `1` | `--mask-erosion-pixels` |
